name: Bangkok
tagline: World-Class City Living at a Fraction of the Price — Retire in Bangkok, Thailand
description: Bangkok delivers the energy, cuisine, and infrastructure of a global megacity at Southeast Asian prices. With its legendary street food, ultra-modern malls, excellent hospitals, and a massive international expat scene, Bangkok offers FIRE retirees a vibrant urban lifestyle that punches far above its cost.

quickFacts.visa: 60-day tourist visa on arrival; Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa for retirees with $80K+ income or $1M+ assets; Thailand Privilege visa ($15K–$30K) for 5–20 year stays
quickFacts.safetyRating: Safe — standard big-city precautions advised; low violent crime
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Suvarnabhumi (BKK) and Don Mueang (DMK) — major international hub with flights worldwide
quickFacts.climate: Tropical wet with hot season (Mar–May), rainy season (Jun–Oct), and cool season (Nov–Feb)

housing.description: Compact studio / small 1BR near a BTS/MRT stop in an affordable pocket (On Nut, Udomsuk, Bang Na), pool + gym

dining.description: Street food and food-court staples daily, occasional casual restaurant

healthcare.description: An individual Thai private plan priced for an early retiree aged 45-55, with access to private hospitals like Phyathai and Saint Louis.

entertainment.description: Markets, rooftop happy hours, gym, streaming, temples

1M.lifestyle: A compact studio or small one-bedroom near a BTS or MRT station in an affordable pocket like On Nut, Udomsuk, or Bang Na, with pool and gym in the building. Daily eating leans on Bangkok's excellent street food and food courts, with home cooking filling the gaps and the occasional casual restaurant. Transit is BTS/MRT-first with a Grab when it is quicker, and a local Thai health plan covers the private hospitals. It is a genuinely modern big-city life on a tight budget — great food and infrastructure are the payoff; space and frequent restaurant dining are the trade-offs.

housing.description: Well-appointed 1-bedroom or 2-bedroom condo in Thong Lo, Ekkamai, or Ari with full facilities

dining.description: Regular restaurant dining across Thai, Japanese, and international cuisines; occasional hotel brunches

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private insurance with Bumrungrad or Bangkok Hospital access

transportation.description: BTS/MRT plus regular Grab rides and occasional taxi trips

entertainment.description: Premium gym, cinema, nightlife in Thong Lo, weekend trips to Hua Hin or Koh Samet

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable one-bedroom in a livelier neighborhood like Ari, Phrom Phong, or Ekkamai, with restaurant meals several times a week across Thai, Japanese, and international kitchens. Grab rides become routine alongside the BTS, and the health plan steps up to a broader private network. Weekend escapes to Hua Hin or Koh Samet are easy. Day-to-day life is easy and unstressed, with real discretionary room. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Well-located 1BR in prime Sukhumvit, Sathorn, or Ari with premium building amenities

dining.description: Regular restaurant dining across cuisines several nights a week, occasional Michelin/omakase

healthcare.description: Comprehensive local Thai plan or entry international, Bumrungrad access

transportation.description: Grab plus a hired car when needed, occasional domestic flights

entertainment.description: Gym, nightlife, spa, memberships, frequent domestic travel

3M.lifestyle: A well-located one-bedroom in prime Sukhumvit, Sathorn, or along the river, with premium building amenities and skyline views. Dining spans the city's best — casual to occasional Michelin and good omakase — several nights a week. A mix of Grab, a hired car when needed, and domestic flights covers mobility, with a comprehensive private or entry international plan for peace of mind. This budget buys a genuinely affluent Bangkok routine with regular travel.

housing.description: Penthouse condo or luxury serviced residence in prime Sathorn or Sukhumvit; alternatively a large house in upscale Nichada Thani

dining.description: Personal chef for weekday meals; Michelin restaurants and exclusive chef's table experiences on weekends

healthcare.description: VIP hospital packages at Bumrungrad with personal health coordinator; global evacuation coverage

transportation.description: Leased luxury sedan with part-time driver; domestic first-class flights; helicopter transfers to resorts

entertainment.description: Royal Bangkok Sports Club membership, art gallery openings, yacht charters to nearby islands, international travel

domesticHelp.description: Live-in maid, part-time cook, and weekly deep-cleaning service

luxuryExtras.description: Bespoke suits from Bangkok tailors, premium wellness retreats, luxury hotel staycations, fine wine collection

5M.lifestyle: A large luxury unit or serviced residence in a prime district, with a housekeeper and part-time cook handling the home. A leased premium car with a part-time driver, business-class regional flights, and VIP hospital access at Bumrungrad. Dining at the top restaurants is routine and the entertainment budget covers clubs, spa, and frequent travel. Bangkok's deep luxury infrastructure is fully within reach. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large prime residence: a riverside high-floor or a spacious home in an upscale enclave

dining.description: Fine dining as routine plus a private chef a few days a week

transportation.description: Car with full-time driver plus domestic first-class flights

entertainment.description: Elite club/culture memberships and frequent international travel

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper plus a part-time cook scaled to one home

luxuryExtras.description: Luxury travel, bespoke tailoring, wellness, memberships

10M.lifestyle: A large prime residence — a riverside high-floor or a spacious home in an upscale enclave — with a housekeeper, a cook a few days a week, and a full-time driver. International evacuation-grade health cover, fine dining as a default, and a generous budget for elite memberships and international travel. This is more than Bangkok demands for a top-tier life: everything runs with no financial friction, though the city's ceiling means it is not the limitless wealth the same figure would imply in a costlier capital.
